programme.title: S02 : E09 The Cook You Want to Be - Cook the Books
programme.desc: Chef-host Shahir Massoud tries out recipes from another award-winning cookbook: The Cook You Want to Be by Andy Baraghani! Follow along as Shahir prepares simple and flavorful dishes like a light citrus salad, shawarma spiced lamb chops, clams with crispy ham, and so much more!

programme.title: S02 : E10 The World Central Kitchen Cookbook - Cook the Books
programme.desc: Chef-host Shahir Massoud tries out recipes from another award-winning cookbook: The World Central Kitchen Cookbook by José Andrés! Follow along as Shahir prepares dishes that World Central Kitchen makes as part of disaster relief efforts all over the world, including beef rendang from Indonesia, lahmajoun from Armenia, potatoes from the Canary Island, and much more!

programme.title: S01 : E01 Classics with a Twist - One BIG Recipe
programme.desc: When planning a multi-course dinner for six, we all think 'go with the classics' and so does sassy chef-host Kim Lallouz. For her, however, it's Classics... with a Twist! Use the One big Recipe and cook along as Bread and Butter gets a smoke, honey, herb, and black sea salt makeover. Next, Shrimp Cocktail is reinvented with a horseradish kick in her Apricot Ketchup. Then, it's Potato Pave as a standalone course, garnished with tangy tarragon crÃ¨me fraiche and briny salmon roe. Prime Rib is as classic as it comes, but with a sous-vide twist and truffle-spiked Pea and Lardon salad, plan to drop everything so you can twist along! For a sweet ending, dress up dessert from your favourite bakery with a cool trick for making easy lavender ice cream. Dinner is love, and you will love this dinner!

programme.title: S03 : E02 Snoop Dogg Part 1 - Cook the Books
programme.desc: Chef-host Shahir Massoud tries out recipes from Snoop Dogg’s Treats to Eat cookbook! Follow along as Shahir makes bacon cheddar scallion biscuits, Basque-style mini cheesecakes, and Mary Jane pudding!

programme.title: S01 : E02 Le Marche - Bonacini's Italy
programme.desc: Celebrity Chef Michael Bonacini explores classic dishes from the central Italian region, Le Marche.

programme.title: S01 : E19 Most Liked, Most Delicious - Griddle Nation
programme.desc: From family favorites to personal go-tos, griddled dishes earn their praise bite after bite. The most liked recipes are what people request again and again, proving the most delicious meals keep people coming back for more.

programme.title: S02 : E02 Allium in the Family - Watts On the Grill
programme.desc: Onions, green onions, chives, garlic, and leeks are all members of the same fabulous flowering family, Allium! First up? Chef Watts shows us his sweet and smoky Charred Leeks with Romesco; add grilled toast and you have your next party appetizer! Next up is a main course. Spencer starts with a juicy grilled pork chop, then adds roasted garlic melted into a balsamic onion chutney to make his out-of-this-world Roasted Garlic Pork Chops. Looking for a crowd pleaser that's easy to make? Spencer has a recipe for that! Chicken Yakitori. He threads skewers with crunchy green onions and tender chicken and caramelizes the yakitori sauce as he grills this tasty dish. Are you ready to drool? Spencer shows us how to make Allium your main dish with Stuffed Vidalia Onions. Loaded with savoury bacon, salty blue cheese and garlic, you'll want to eat this dish for every meal!

programme.title: S01 : E11 Fowl Play - Watts On the Grill
programme.desc: Whether for a small family dinner or a big backyard barbeque, host Spencer Watts shows us the best ways to grill up tasty duck, turkey, capon, and quail.

programme.title: S01 : E12 Sides & Sweets with Heat - Watts On the Grill
programme.desc: Never underestimate the power of a good side or dessert! Fun host Spencer Watts grills up the perfect sides and treats for your next barbeque.

programme.title: S01 : E07 Mother Sauces + Spice - Spice Secrets
programme.desc: Every cook needs to learn their Mother Sauces before they can claim the title of Chef. Spice Secrets co-hosts Shahir Massoud and Jasmin Ibrahim are no different, though their sauce recipes sure are! First, a traditional Tomato Sauce re-examined as a Bucatini All'Amatriciana spiced with Quatre Épices! Next, a rich veal Demi-Glace spiced two different ways, served with veal chops and Roasted Mushrooms! Finally, a spin on a classic Béarnaise Sauce, replacing tarragon with Aniseed.

programme.title: S01 : E08 The Root of all Spices - Spice Secrets
programme.desc: Co-hosts Jasmin Ibrahim and Shahir Massoud get to the "root" of spicing up your food as they cook dishes using spice roots! First up, they prepare a creamy Carrot and Galangal Soup, however they don't use cream, opting for cashews instead! Next up, a frosty, golden Turmeric Semifreddo, studded with jewel-like apricots and pistachios! Last but not least is a steaming bowl of mussels, spiced with not one, not two, but three kinds of ginger! How can you not 'root' for these dishes?

programme.title: S01 : E09 Spice Blends - Spice Secrets
programme.desc: Spices were meant to be used in tandem, and our co-hosts Jasmin Ibrahim and Shahir Massoud will show you how! Cook along as they make a creamy, golden, Risotto Milanese, spiced not just with saffron, but with Ras el Hanout: a spice blend like no other! Next, a master class in spice blends and infusing them into oils, all topped off with some skewers of plump, juicy grilled shrimp. Finally, delicate Red Snapper is coated in aromatic Dukkah and served with a fresh Tomato and Chickpea Salad!

programme.title: S01 : E10 Seeds, Bark + Flower Parts - Spice Secrets
programme.desc: In this tasty episode of Spice Secrets, Jasmin and Shahir are back to spicing things up with everything from seed to bark to flower part! First up? A yummy French classic, the Croque Madame, gets a new twist with an aromatic Cinnamon Bechamel. Next, Potato Gnocchi gets some pep from poppy seeds, served in rich creamy sauce that's infused with aureate strands of sultry saffron. For a sweet finish, dessert finds an unusual friend in dill seed! A surprise pairing that works well thanks to science!

programme.title: S01 : E01 Italy + China - CombiNation Plates
programme.desc: Join engaging host, Bianca Osbourne, for a taste of two countries. First stop? Italy! Check out her recipe for succulent wild boar ribs, braised until tender, rolled in gremolata, and served over silky polenta. Next up? A culinary tribute to China, pairing lobster claw with chili oil, pomelo foam, and oyster sauce glazed bok choy. Every episode features a 'common ingredient', this time? It's noodles! Drool over two recipes: Italian classic Olio e Aglio next to chewy Chinese long Noodles tossed with Sichuan Chili Oil. For the big finale, Bianca blends Italian style with Chinese flavour for a one-of-a-kind CombiNation Plate: Kung Pao Pork Osso Bucco over Forbidden Black Rice Risotto... made with shiitake mushrooms and bright green edamame peas.

programme.title: S01 : E02 Turkey + Indonesia - CombiNation Plates
programme.desc: Turkey, think Silk Road spices. Indonesia, lots of seafood and tropical fruits! Curious and adventurous host Bianca Osbourne is your CombiNATION Plates culinary guide through both food cultures. First, check out Turkish Spice Crusted Lamb Rack with yogurt and blistered peppers. Next, an Indonesian tribute: Crab Leg with Coconut Curry. For the 'common ingredient'? Two takes on tender, savoury eggplant! Turkish Eggplant is braised and served with parsley and feta and the Indonesian take is served with fried garlic and sweet soy. For the CombiNATION Plate? Peanut- chili Sate sauce replaces walnut for Pazili TrancÌ§a, a classically Turkish halibut presentation, also served here with unique, savoury, coconut 'baklava' for a plate no-one has ever seen before!

programme.title: S02 : E09 Grilled Bites & Backyard Delights - Maddie and Kiki's BBQ Barn
programme.desc: Maddie and Kiki are firing up the grill for a colourful mix of fresh flavours and backyard favourites! On this episode, they make a charred corn, red pepper, and arugula salad, grill a shrimp pizza on flatbread, and serve up lamb sliders topped with Fuji apple chutney.

programme.title: S02 : E10 Ribs, Roots & Sweet Rewards - Maddie and Kiki's BBQ Barn
programme.desc: Maddie and Kiki are embracing big BBQ flavours with a feast of smoky meats, fresh sides, and sweet finishes! On this episode, they smoke whole beef ribs with maple butter acorn squash, grill Korean short ribs with celeriac and apple slaw, and create a strawberry mascarpone trifle.

programme.title: S02 : E08 Sweet - Fish the Dish
programme.desc: Satisfy your craving for something sweet with these delicious sablefish and lobster dishes from chef and seafood lover Spencer Watts.

programme.title: S02 : E09 Fast Favs - Fish the Dish
programme.desc: For a quick and tasty meal, chef Spencer Watts cooks up fast favs using scallops and trout, all done in under 30 minutes.

programme.title: S01 : E19 Most Liked, Most Delicious - Griddle Nation
programme.desc: From family favorites to personal go-tos, griddled dishes earn their praise bite after bite. The most liked recipes are what people request again and again, proving the most delicious meals keep people coming back for more.

programme.title: S01 : E18 Fresh Catch Feast - Griddle Nation
programme.desc: Fresh-caught flavor meets griddle heat in a celebration of seafood at its best. Blending coastal heritage with inventive technique, the day’s catch is transformed into flavorful dishes that celebrate the beauty of the sea and the spirit of home.

programme.title: S02 : E02 Allium in the Family - Watts On the Grill
programme.desc: Onions, green onions, chives, garlic, and leeks are all members of the same fabulous flowering family, Allium! First up? Chef Watts shows us his sweet and smoky Charred Leeks with Romesco; add grilled toast and you have your next party appetizer! Next up is a main course. Spencer starts with a juicy grilled pork chop, then adds roasted garlic melted into a balsamic onion chutney to make his out-of-this-world Roasted Garlic Pork Chops. Looking for a crowd pleaser that's easy to make? Spencer has a recipe for that! Chicken Yakitori. He threads skewers with crunchy green onions and tender chicken and caramelizes the yakitori sauce as he grills this tasty dish. Are you ready to drool? Spencer shows us how to make Allium your main dish with Stuffed Vidalia Onions. Loaded with savoury bacon, salty blue cheese and garlic, you'll want to eat this dish for every meal!

programme.title: S01 : E06 Vegetable - The Wizard Of Sauce
programme.desc: Chef Kyle Crawford pulls back the curtain on veggie sauces! First up, a Provencal sauce tomate to go with halibut! Next, a rustic pepperonata with flank steak and a trio of pestos!

programme.title: S02 : E09 The Cook You Want to Be - Cook the Books
programme.desc: Chef-host Shahir Massoud tries out recipes from another award-winning cookbook: The Cook You Want to Be by Andy Baraghani! Follow along as Shahir prepares simple and flavorful dishes like a light citrus salad, shawarma spiced lamb chops, clams with crispy ham, and so much more!

programme.title: S02 : E10 The World Central Kitchen Cookbook - Cook the Books
programme.desc: Chef-host Shahir Massoud tries out recipes from another award-winning cookbook: The World Central Kitchen Cookbook by José Andrés! Follow along as Shahir prepares dishes that World Central Kitchen makes as part of disaster relief efforts all over the world, including beef rendang from Indonesia, lahmajoun from Armenia, potatoes from the Canary Island, and much more!

programme.title: S01 : E01 Classics with a Twist - One BIG Recipe
programme.desc: When planning a multi-course dinner for six, we all think 'go with the classics' and so does sassy chef-host Kim Lallouz. For her, however, it's Classics... with a Twist! Use the One big Recipe and cook along as Bread and Butter gets a smoke, honey, herb, and black sea salt makeover. Next, Shrimp Cocktail is reinvented with a horseradish kick in her Apricot Ketchup. Then, it's Potato Pave as a standalone course, garnished with tangy tarragon crÃ¨me fraiche and briny salmon roe. Prime Rib is as classic as it comes, but with a sous-vide twist and truffle-spiked Pea and Lardon salad, plan to drop everything so you can twist along! For a sweet ending, dress up dessert from your favourite bakery with a cool trick for making easy lavender ice cream. Dinner is love, and you will love this dinner!

programme.title: S01 : E02 Spring Inspiration - One BIG Recipe
programme.desc: Spring is in the air for this multi-course dinner One Big Recipe with engaging Chef Kimberly Lallouz. First up, it's Scallop Crudo, and it's peachy! Literally! Lamb Shanks braised with olives and sun-dried tomatoes are next, as an appetizer ragout, lovingly stuffed into pillowy, perfect mini-Yorkshire Puddings. Next, verdant spears of asparagus appear, topped with creamy, crunchy, soft-cooked egg Sauce Gribiche. Halibut is the main event, pan-roasted steaks are served over king trumpet Dill Pesto Mushrooms and finished with many melty coins of punchy Pink Peppercorn Compound Butter. The entire dinner is laid out in the signature One Big Recipe format, easy to follow, easy to make and guaranteed to impress!

programme.title: S01 : E19 Most Liked, Most Delicious - Griddle Nation
programme.desc: From family favorites to personal go-tos, griddled dishes earn their praise bite after bite. The most liked recipes are what people request again and again, proving the most delicious meals keep people coming back for more.

programme.title: S01 : E08 Morocco + Thailand - CombiNation Plates
programme.desc: Join CombiNATION Plates host Bianca Osbourne for a trip to Morocco and Thailand! First up, whole Red Snapper is rubbed with earthy Ras el Hanout spice, poached in argan oil, and served with char-grilled oranges. Thailand inspires the next plate; Chicken Thigh 'Lollipop', roasted and served with bamboo shoots, chilies, and sauced with peanut-coconut red curry. Next, these countries both love Spring Rolls... Morocco's version, Briouat, is stuffed with saffron couscous and fresh cheese and fried... from Thailand comes a salad roll with shrimp and mango, dipped in a fiery green Nam Jim. Stick around for the big dish - Saffron buttERS-basted beef Striploin, served with complex Apricot-Green Curry Chutney and sent spinning with never before seen Chermoula Grass Jelly!

programme.desc: Vanessa and Stefania plan a rustic Italian menu with a table to match! There’s nonna’s salad, Sunday sauce, rapini with garlic and chili, Sicilian sea bass, and so much more!

programme.title: S01 : E03 Meet the Peppers - Spice Secrets
programme.desc: Chefs Shahir Massoud and Jasmin Ibrahim have picked a peck of peppery recipes this time on Spice Secrets! Start off with something sweet: strawberry shortcakes featuring three different peppercorns: black, white, and pink! After that, a Japanese take on Tuna Ceviche when they infuse a trio of smoky Mexican chili peppers into citrusy ponzu sauce! And who can resist crispy fried chicken wings? Especially when they're spiced up with Chinese five-spice and served with a Sichuan pepper hot honey!

programme.title: S01 : E04 Uncommon Curry - Spice Secrets
programme.desc: If mace, fenugreek, and cloves aren't at the front of your spice shelf yet, they will be by the end of this episode! Co-hosts Shahir Massoud and Jasmin Ibrahim bring these spices to a trio of fabulous recipes! First, octopus gets a slow bath in mace-scented olive oil before picking up a smoky char on the grill. A refreshing Thai Mango Salad gets amped up with the big flavour of fenugreek. Lastly, lamb chops get treated to an aromatic marinade of clove-spiked basil and parsley pesto.

programme.title: S01 : E05 Spice + Fat - Spice Secrets
programme.desc: Co-hosts Shahir Massoud and Jasmin Ibrahim explore the relationship between spices and fats in three rich recipes. Juicy watermelon gets treated two ways: as a sauce and as a spicy pickle, both to top a caraway-infused Panna Cotta! Next, a lesson in infusing spice into compound butters: a zingy Za'atar and Lemon Butter for bread and a smoky Paprika and Bay Butter for Grilled Steak! Finally, flaky cod gets basted in juniper and rosemary butter before being sat on a bed of du puy lentils!

programme.title: S01 : E06 Spice + Sweet - Spice Secrets
programme.desc: On this sweet episode of Spice Secrets, chef/hosts Jasmin Ibrahim and Shahir Massoud cook three dishes that all represent the sweeter side of cooking with spice, though not in the way you'd expect! You'll never see donuts the same way again after trying Chocolate-Glazed Coriander Donuts"... with a Cilantro-Lime filling! Next, Asian Spring Rolls and Plum Sauce meet both Spanish Smoky and Hungarian Sweet Paprikas! Finally, a truly unique dish that can only be described as Duck Meets Vanilla.

programme.desc: Maddie and Kiki bring their signature mix of BBQ expertise, playful banter and mouthwatering recipes back to the BBQ Barn. This time, they grill fennel with anchovy garlic butter, roast stuffed apricot Dijon pork chops and serve a vibrant watermelon, feta and black olive salad.

programme.title: S02 : E03 Seafood Skewers & Sweet, Smoky Salsa - Maddie and Kiki's BBQ Barn
programme.desc: Maddie and Kiki are back at the barn with smoky flavours, fresh ideas, and BBQ favourites! On this episode, they make crab cakes with smoky peach salsa, grill swordfish and scallop skewers with curried corn sauce, and toss a grilled vegetable couscous salad.

programme.title: S02 : E04 Mediterranean Grill & Barnyard Thrills - Maddie and Kiki's BBQ Barn
programme.desc: Fresh ingredients meet bold BBQ flavours as Maddie and Kiki put a smoky spin on Mediterranean favourites. They smoke heirloom tomatoes for a basil and bocconcini salad, glaze grilled mushroom kebabs with balsamic, and finish with juicy lamb souvlaki served alongside cool tzatziki.

programme.title: S02 : E05 Smoked Turkey & Sweet Summer Treats - Maddie and Kiki's BBQ Barn
programme.desc: The barn is heating up as Maddie and Kiki serve up a lineup of smoky, savoury, and sweet BBQ favourites! This time, they create their own turkey pastrami, build a spinach salad with bacon and cashews, and turn grilled pineapple into a delicious campfire-inspired treat.

programme.title: S02 : E06 Fish, Fire & Fruity Flair - Maddie and Kiki's BBQ Barn
programme.desc: Maddie and Kiki are turning up the heat with a BBQ feast full of bold flavours and creative combinations! On this episode, they smoke prosciutto-wrapped jalapeño poppers, toss a baby arugula salad with pine nuts and grilled nectarines, and serve whole grilled trout with strawberry salsa.

programme.title: S02 : E07 Smoky Prime Rib & Summer Berry Bliss - Maddie and Kiki's BBQ Barn
programme.desc: Maddie and Kiki are serving up a BBQ feast packed with smoky flavours and creative twists! On this episode, they load up grilled potato skins with lardons and pico de gallo, smoke a tender prime rib with a fresh watercress salad, and finish with a summer berry pudding topped with toasted almonds.

programme.title: S02 : E08 Rotisserie, Plums & Sister Fun - Maddie and Kiki's BBQ Barn
programme.desc: Maddie and Kiki are bringing global flavours to the grill with a fresh lineup of BBQ favourites! On this episode, they toss together an Asian pasta salad with charred green onions, roast lemon chicken on the spit with chili lime aioli, and grill plums served with lime mascarpone.

programme.title: S02 : E09 Grilled Bites & Backyard Delights - Maddie and Kiki's BBQ Barn
programme.desc: Maddie and Kiki are firing up the grill for a colourful mix of fresh flavours and backyard favourites! On this episode, they make a charred corn, red pepper, and arugula salad, grill a shrimp pizza on flatbread, and serve up lamb sliders topped with Fuji apple chutney.

programme.title: S02 : E04 Mediterranean Grill & Barnyard Thrills - Maddie and Kiki's BBQ Barn
programme.desc: Fresh ingredients meet bold BBQ flavours as Maddie and Kiki put a smoky spin on Mediterranean favourites. They smoke heirloom tomatoes for a basil and bocconcini salad, glaze grilled mushroom kebabs with balsamic, and finish with juicy lamb souvlaki served alongside cool tzatziki.

programme.title: S02 : E04 Achin' for Bacon - Watts On the Grill
programme.desc: In this bacon loving episode, Chef Spencer delivers a tasty Bacon Weave Turkey Breast, which gets injected with beer and spices before being wrapped up in its cozy bacon blanket and sent off to the grill! Next up? A Peameal Bacon Roast with Rosti. This heavy hunk of back bacon gets smoked to flavourful perfection while Chef Watts makes the crispiest golden-fried-to-perfection potato pancake. Then, Spencer whips up a charry, grilled, super decadent, bacon-wrapped and bacon stuffed cheeseburger. Spencer isn't finished with bacon yet! For his final recipe, Spencer stuffs an apple with decadent crispy morsels stuffed along with savoury caramelized onions and melty cheddar cheese.

programme.title: S02 : E05 Grilled Veggies - Watts On the Grill
programme.desc: This episode kicks off with Spencer's tasty Grilled Caesar Salad. He skillfully piles of char-grilled romaine lettuce wedges and sourdough croutons are topped with tangy dressing, crispy pancetta, and shards of a homemade parmesan tuile. For his next recipe, Spencer whips up Grilled Zucchini Boats that filled with fresh ingredients including orzo pasta, summer veggies, and herbs. Chef Watts loves a good steak and his Grilled Cauliflower Steak is not one to be passed up! Dusted in Middle Eastern Spices, flame roasted and served with chili-spiked, Yemeni 'Skhug' hot sauce and pomegranate seeds. Finally, Spencer steams tender artichokes, stuffing these flowers with breadcrumbs and stretchy-melty cheese, and finishes this delicious dish on the grill.

programme.title: S02 : E06 Handheld Party Foods - Watts On the Grill
programme.desc: The most liked post on any grill-master's social feed is 'meat on a stick' - and Chef Spencer's Turkish-style chicken kabob is worth every click! He marinates thick juicy chicken morsels in yogurt and spices, and then grills these flavourful skewers to a charry perfection. Next up is the creative 'Tornado Potato' which re- invents grilled potatoes with a wild presentation and a trio of toppings. Spencer then assembles Char Siu Sliders on tiny party- ready buns. Stuffed with a soy, honey and umami-packed hoisin lacquered slow-and-low grilled pork belly, these tasty little sliders will have your taste buds tingling. For his final recipe, Spencer whips up toasted crispy roti cups; topping them with plump and majestic grilled prawns and stuffed with a layered spicy chickpea curry. Now that's a BBQ party!

programme.title: S02 : E07 Fire & Spice - Watts On the Grill
programme.desc: Chef Spencer starts this spicy barbeque episode with flavours from Thailand with a Bok Choy with a Ginger Chili Sauce. Powerful bird's eye chilies are packed into a sweet and spicy sauce and served over tasty grilled bok choy. Spencer then introduces us to Calabrian chilies, mashed into a spice paste and rubbed on butterflied chicken that then gets grilled to flame-kissed perfection. Next, Spencer gives fresh calamari some heat with Korean chilies that add their distinctive heat and flavour before grilling this scrumptious recipe and serving it over a comforting bed of rice and peas. Finally, Spencer prepares Seekh Kabobs, made with ground lamb spiked with punchy dried Kashmiri chilies and a blend of fresh hot peppers.

programme.title: S02 : E08 Spanish Flare - Watts On the Grill
programme.desc: First stop on Chef Spencer's Spanish flavour tour? Habanero Char-Grilled Octopus - warmed up with punchy chilies and balanced with a sweet and tangy sherry vinaigrette. Next, Spencer stuffs whole sea bass with citrus and herbs, gives it the grill treatment and then tops it with olive oil blistered cherry tomatoes. The rotisserie does the heavy lifting for Mr. Watts' whole roast chicken - spiked with bright Spanish flavours like Spanish chilies and smoked paprika, slow cooked and served extra juicy. Finally, Spencer prepares a classic Spanish recipe: Paella. Loaded saffron rice, piled high with chorizo, veggies, and shellfish. Of course, Spencer's Paella is made in the Spanish tradition; outside, over the fire, on a beautiful sunny day!

programme.title: S02 : E09 The Butter Did It - Watts On the Grill
programme.desc: It's all about beautiful butter in this episode of Watts on the Grill! First up, entertaining host Spencer fires tosses clams in velvety butter, zesty garlic and earthy spices to make his Clams with Garlic Paprika Butter. Next up is a traditional Indian recipe, but done on the grill - Butter Chicken! All the butter chicken flavours we love are infused in the marinade, before getting crisped up on the fiery grill - the result is both classic and completely new! Scallops are next, grilled and served with a mouth-watering caper-raisin butter. For his final recipe; Chef Watts prepares a rich and juicy grilled Rib Steak topped with a decadent port wine compound butter. Oh, what a butter-loving day!

programme.title: S02 : E10 Salt Rocks! - Watts On the Grill
programme.desc: We've all cooked with salt. But what about ON salt. That's right, chef Spencer Watts blows our minds with his seared scallops that are cooked on a Himalayan pink salt block. His next recipe uses a quick cure with Hawaiian black lava salt on swordfish steaks, then tops them with a gorgeous and refreshing grilled fruit salsa. Then, Spencer gets creative with Cured Duck Legs with Scallions, using a salt cure to intensify the flavours of duck leg before it's cooked slow and low, then glazed with maple and soy. After cooking on salt, curing with salt, the only thing left is to cook INSIDE salt - Spencer's Salt Crusted Prime Rib is a game changer, flavourful, bone-in beef that he seasons with a big, bold Dijon mustard, rosemary and horseradish rub before encasing it completely in a classic salt crust and sending it to the grill.

programme.title: S02 : E11 Cocoa-Q - Watts On the Grill
programme.desc: Chocolate on the barbecue? That's right. Chef Spencer Watts kicks off this episode as he grills a crispy coconut-cacao crust and serves it with sweet chili dipping sauce. Chocolate is the not-so-secret ingredient in Spencer's Grilled Chicken Molé. He grills the chicken legs smothered in the sweet-spicy-salty-nutty-creamy-chocolatey sauce, then finishes it by cooking it slow and low. Next, dark chocolate cocoa powder is in both the rub and the sauce for Chef Watts' favourite pork rib recipe - Cocoa-rubbed Baby Back Ribs. For his final recipe, Spencer takes it to a sweet level with his Chocolate pizza made with chocolate ganache, grilled cherries, with barbeque- caramelized white chocolate crumble over the top.

programme.title: S02 : E12 The Art of Wood - Watts On the Grill
programme.desc: It's time to celebrate the art of smoking with wood! You'll drool over Spencer's Cherrywood Smoked Chicken Wings, dry rubbed with his favourite spices and smoked with cherrywood. Next, Spencer marinates sable fish in Japanese ingredients and grills it on a sweet-smoky cedar plank. Then, Spencer shows off his Texas BBQ skills with his Mesquite Smoked Skirt Steak. Engulfed in a thick cloud of white smoke, this skirt steak has the flavour and texture of tasty brisket, but made in a fraction amount of time. Finally, Spencer gives a pork shoulder a long, smoky cook in oak wood. The wait is worth it as he serves it piled high on a bun and topped with a mustardy Carolina BBQ sauce.

programme.title: S01 : E01 Classics with a Twist - One BIG Recipe
programme.desc: When planning a multi-course dinner for six, we all think 'go with the classics' and so does sassy chef-host Kim Lallouz. For her, however, it's Classics... with a Twist! Use the One big Recipe and cook along as Bread and Butter gets a smoke, honey, herb, and black sea salt makeover. Next, Shrimp Cocktail is reinvented with a horseradish kick in her Apricot Ketchup. Then, it's Potato Pave as a standalone course, garnished with tangy tarragon crÃ¨me fraiche and briny salmon roe. Prime Rib is as classic as it comes, but with a sous-vide twist and truffle-spiked Pea and Lardon salad, plan to drop everything so you can twist along! For a sweet ending, dress up dessert from your favourite bakery with a cool trick for making easy lavender ice cream. Dinner is love, and you will love this dinner!

programme.title: S01 : E02 Spring Inspiration - One BIG Recipe
programme.desc: Spring is in the air for this multi-course dinner One Big Recipe with engaging Chef Kimberly Lallouz. First up, it's Scallop Crudo, and it's peachy! Literally! Lamb Shanks braised with olives and sun-dried tomatoes are next, as an appetizer ragout, lovingly stuffed into pillowy, perfect mini-Yorkshire Puddings. Next, verdant spears of asparagus appear, topped with creamy, crunchy, soft-cooked egg Sauce Gribiche. Halibut is the main event, pan-roasted steaks are served over king trumpet Dill Pesto Mushrooms and finished with many melty coins of punchy Pink Peppercorn Compound Butter. The entire dinner is laid out in the signature One Big Recipe format, easy to follow, easy to make and guaranteed to impress!

programme.title: S01 : E03 Upside Down - One BIG Recipe
programme.desc: Last things are first for this 'Upside Down' themed One Big Recipe featuring Montreal chef Kimberly Lallouz. Fruit and cheese to start? Why not? Check out her dessert wine poached Grilled Pears and Blue Cheese Salad. Next, Beef Tartare Sliders are spiked with horseradish aioli and served on warm brioche. Pasta follows, but in keeping with her topsy turvy theme, Korean flavour meets Italian savour in her Kimchi Pappardelle. Fish is next, Loup de Mer en Papillote with Ã‰crasé Potatoes is dressed up with shaved fennel and rich beurre rouge sauce. How do you end an inside-outside- upside-downside dinner? With the perfect starter! Check out Kim's Oyster Shooters with Champagne Granité for a perfect final note...

programme.title: S01 : E04 Surf and Turf - One BIG Recipe
programme.desc: What on earth and/or sea is super fun host Kim Lallouz cooking this week for her One Big Recipe? You guessed it - Surf and Turf! First on the beach are her Singapore-inspired Chili Crab Cakes, redolent with southeast Asian aromatics and spices like lemongrass, ginger, and galangal. 'Turf's up' next with a fresh off-the-hoof Marrow Toast plate decked out with melty marrow, crispy crostini, and garlicky parsley salad. We all deserve a creamy cheesy break (right?), so of course Risotto Carbonara with Crispy Pancetta and Enoki Mushrooms follows. Braised Veal Osso Bucco is the big deal main course, all shored up surfingly with scrumptious Seared Scallops and smoky Grilled Broccoli Rabe!

programme.title: S01 : E05 Sweet Kisses - One BIG Recipe
programme.desc: Who doesn't love Sweet Kisses? Join Chef Kimberly Lallouz as she showers them on her multi-course feast all laid out in One Big Recipe. Her Spicy Cornbread gets the first peck with lip-smacking Honey Butter. Then, it's a berry... nice smooch for a seared rare Duck Breast appetizer with Cherries and Walnuts. Avocado Honeydew Gazpacho follows, silky and savoury, with just a gentle sugary buss from the melon, it's a chilled soup gorgeously garnished with crostini and mascarpone. Citrus smooches Salmon on the main course, butter basted and presented with shattered dried citrus shards sprinkled over top and Basmati with Cranberries and Rice Vinegar alongside. Anyone can do it! It's all in the One Big Recipe.

programme.title: S01 : E06 Wow Factor - One BIG Recipe
programme.desc: What sets this cool One Big Recipe by charismatic chef-host Kimberly Lallouz apart? Folks, may I introduce the 'Wow Factor'? It's that hard- to-define special something, but we know it when we see it! Ogle her Chilled Mussels over Grilled Baguette lightly drizzled with vibrant, golden Saffron Aioli. Gasp at the golden gorgeous Roasted Mini Butternuts, ever so very vivacious with their Salsa Verde, tart Goat Cheese, and nutty toasted sunflower seed garnishes. Bone-in Veal Roast with an easy-to-execute and guaranteed-to-wow presentation is the apex of the event, with grainy mustard vinaigrette-dressed Charred Bok Choy halves. Dessert gets a moment in the spotlight, summer berries draped with applause-inspiring vanilla whipped cream and sweet, crunchy Macadamia Streusel.

programme.title: S01 : E07 Spiced Up! - One BIG Recipe
programme.desc: Well-traveled chef Kimberly Lallouz has familial ties to India, Morocco, and Spain, with culinary adventures from the Far East to the Deep South. Her 'Spiced Up!' One Big Recipe tries to tell a few chapters of that flavourful story on the plate. Starting on the milder side of the spice cabinet, Herbes de Provence inspires her Mediterranean Tomato Tart with Basil CrÃ¨me Fraiche. Next, South American spice meets northern ingredients in Arctic Char Ceviche with Rhubarb Vinaigrette. The centerpiece of her spice-studded supper is a Silk Road surprise, Cous-Cous Royale with Cornish Game Hens, Merguez Sausage and seasonal veggies. To finish, check out sweet, tangy, and pungent Blueberry Mostarda, served with creamy Burrata and Grainy Seed Loaf.

programme.title: S01 : E08 Vegetarian Dinner - One BIG Recipe
programme.desc: Protein-packed plant-based foods are on the One Big Recipe for chef Kimberly Lallouz's Vegetarian Dinner, five fun, filling courses designed for both vegetarians and omnivores. First up is yummy White Bean Hummus, served with pita, topped with savoury Caramelized Onion Jam and fried sage. Next is umami-packed Grilled Treviso Salad with arugula pesto, red grapes, and pine nuts. Brussels Sprouts shine in her Kimchi-inspired Korean take, topped with crunchy brown butter cashews. Salt Crusted Potato with Chive Oil will wow even the most skeptical carnivore in your orbit, and to finish, Pasta Giardina is a painting on a plate, tossing together multi-hued ribbons of garden veggies with fresh peas, mint, and a crumble of satisfying ricotta salata cheese.

programme.title: S01 : E07 Mother Sauces + Spice - Spice Secrets
programme.desc: Every cook needs to learn their Mother Sauces before they can claim the title of Chef. Spice Secrets co-hosts Shahir Massoud and Jasmin Ibrahim are no different, though their sauce recipes sure are! First, a traditional Tomato Sauce re-examined as a Bucatini All'Amatriciana spiced with Quatre Épices! Next, a rich veal Demi-Glace spiced two different ways, served with veal chops and Roasted Mushrooms! Finally, a spin on a classic Béarnaise Sauce, replacing tarragon with Aniseed.

programme.title: S01 : E08 The Root of all Spices - Spice Secrets
programme.desc: Co-hosts Jasmin Ibrahim and Shahir Massoud get to the "root" of spicing up your food as they cook dishes using spice roots! First up, they prepare a creamy Carrot and Galangal Soup, however they don't use cream, opting for cashews instead! Next up, a frosty, golden Turmeric Semifreddo, studded with jewel-like apricots and pistachios! Last but not least is a steaming bowl of mussels, spiced with not one, not two, but three kinds of ginger! How can you not 'root' for these dishes?

programme.title: S01 : E09 Spice Blends - Spice Secrets
programme.desc: Spices were meant to be used in tandem, and our co-hosts Jasmin Ibrahim and Shahir Massoud will show you how! Cook along as they make a creamy, golden, Risotto Milanese, spiced not just with saffron, but with Ras el Hanout: a spice blend like no other! Next, a master class in spice blends and infusing them into oils, all topped off with some skewers of plump, juicy grilled shrimp. Finally, delicate Red Snapper is coated in aromatic Dukkah and served with a fresh Tomato and Chickpea Salad!

programme.title: S01 : E10 Seeds, Bark + Flower Parts - Spice Secrets
programme.desc: In this tasty episode of Spice Secrets, Jasmin and Shahir are back to spicing things up with everything from seed to bark to flower part! First up? A yummy French classic, the Croque Madame, gets a new twist with an aromatic Cinnamon Bechamel. Next, Potato Gnocchi gets some pep from poppy seeds, served in rich creamy sauce that's infused with aureate strands of sultry saffron. For a sweet finish, dessert finds an unusual friend in dill seed! A surprise pairing that works well thanks to science!

programme.title: S01 : E01 Italy + China - CombiNation Plates
programme.desc: Join engaging host, Bianca Osbourne, for a taste of two countries. First stop? Italy! Check out her recipe for succulent wild boar ribs, braised until tender, rolled in gremolata, and served over silky polenta. Next up? A culinary tribute to China, pairing lobster claw with chili oil, pomelo foam, and oyster sauce glazed bok choy. Every episode features a 'common ingredient', this time? It's noodles! Drool over two recipes: Italian classic Olio e Aglio next to chewy Chinese long Noodles tossed with Sichuan Chili Oil. For the big finale, Bianca blends Italian style with Chinese flavour for a one-of-a-kind CombiNation Plate: Kung Pao Pork Osso Bucco over Forbidden Black Rice Risotto... made with shiitake mushrooms and bright green edamame peas.

programme.title: S01 : E02 Turkey + Indonesia - CombiNation Plates
programme.desc: Turkey, think Silk Road spices. Indonesia, lots of seafood and tropical fruits! Curious and adventurous host Bianca Osbourne is your CombiNATION Plates culinary guide through both food cultures. First, check out Turkish Spice Crusted Lamb Rack with yogurt and blistered peppers. Next, an Indonesian tribute: Crab Leg with Coconut Curry. For the 'common ingredient'? Two takes on tender, savoury eggplant! Turkish Eggplant is braised and served with parsley and feta and the Indonesian take is served with fried garlic and sweet soy. For the CombiNATION Plate? Peanut- chili Sate sauce replaces walnut for Pazili TrancÌ§a, a classically Turkish halibut presentation, also served here with unique, savoury, coconut 'baklava' for a plate no-one has ever seen before!

programme.title: S01 : E03 Canada + Greece - CombiNation Plates
programme.desc: From Canada to Greece, CombiNATION Plates always covers lots of ground! Kicking off, host Bianca Osbourne wows with ubERS-Canadian Roasted Venison Loin, yummy Fiddlehead Pancakes and sweet-tart Cranberry sauce. Next, enjoy a scenic Mediterranean vacation on a plate with her completely new approach to Greek Salad, taken up a notch or two with tasty seared Albacore Tuna! This episode's 'common ingredient' is lamb shank; check out two wildly creative re- inventions; first, of Canadian TourtieÌ€re, and then, Greek Dolmades. For a final recipe, a dessert fit for a lumberjack or a Greek god! Oka Saganaki with McIntosh Apple Butter and Maple Loukoumades; made with nutty Canadian Oka cheese, fried crisp, flambeÌed with Ouzo, then dusted with dried raspberry powder and maple sugar flakes. 'Opa!' meets Oka!

programme.title: S01 : E04 Mexico + Norway - CombiNation Plates
programme.desc: In this episode of CombiNATION Plates, host Bianca Osbourne starts in Mexico with her version of popular street snack, 'Esquites', re-invented here as sweet corn flan. Next is Norway, don't miss explosively exciting quick-smoked Arctic Char with Forage, you've NEVER seen anything like this before. The common ingredient is tacos! From Norway, 'Lefse' is a potato-flour 'tortilla' served with fresh berries and uniquely Scandinavian 'Brunost' cheese. Representing Mexico, check out spicy pork and pineapple 'Tacos al Pastor'. The Big Dish is Lamb Pinnekjott with Birch Bark Tamale, lamb ribs are seasoned, birch bark is stuffed with masa and veggies, both are steamed over birch branches and boozy Akvavit, then plated with dill and bright red chili oil.

programme.title: S01 : E09 Cajun Night - Feed My Soul, V!
programme.desc: Vanessa plans a cajun-themed menu with a table to match! There's chili-garlic-cilantro shrimp, fajita rice, cornbread, tomato salad, and so much more!

programme.title: S01 : E10 Winter Feast - Feed My Soul, V!
programme.desc: Vanessa plans a winter-themed menu with a table to match! There's cheddar biscuits, a detox kale salad, roast beef au jus, root vegetable mash, and so much more!

programme.title: S01 : E11 Veggies with V - Feed My Soul, V!
programme.desc: Vanessa plans a vegetable-forward menu with a table to match! There's lentils and mushrooms, watermelon salad, a farro and squash wellington, Eton mess, and so much more!

programme.title: S01 : E12 Mezze Marathon - Feed My Soul, V!
programme.desc: Vanessa plans a Mediterranean mezze-themed menu with a table to match! There's kofta, hummus, tabbouleh, fattoush, muhammara, and so much more!

programme.title: S01 : E01 France, Japan, Morocco, Mexico - Global Veggies
programme.desc: Join chef Pino Di Cerbo in the Global Veggies kitchen as he creates veggie dishes inspired by France - French Fennel Soup, Japan - Unagi-Style Soy Glazed Figs, Morocco - Moroccan Butterbean Tagine, and Mexico - Asparagus Ceviche!

programme.title: S01 : E02 Thailand, France, Sweden, Italy - Global Veggies
programme.desc: Join chef Pino Di Cerbo in the Global Veggies kitchen as he creates veggie dishes inspired by Thailand - Carrot Pad Thai, France - Ground Cherry Salad, Sweden - Swedish Pecan Balls, and Italy - Corn Farroto!

programme.title: S01 : E03 Vietnam, Lebanon, China, Germany - Global Veggies
programme.desc: Join chef Pino Di Cerbo in the Global Veggies kitchen as he creates veggie dishes inspired by Vietnam - Vietnamese Green Beans, Lebanon - Watermelon Tabbouleh, China - Signapore-Style Spaghetti Squash Noodles, and Germany - Celeriac Sauerbraten and Slaw!

programme.title: S01 : E04 Italy, Morocco, Ethiopia, Jamaica - Global Veggies
programme.desc: Join chef Pino Di Cerbo in the Global Veggies kitchen as he creates veggie dishes inspired by Italy - Roasted Radishes and Radish Pesto, Morocco - Moroccan Spiced Apples, Ethiopia - Ethiopian Spinach Dip, and Jamaica - Jerk Shiitakes with Coconut Rice!

programme.title: S01 : E05 Georgia + Hong Kong - CombiNation Plates
programme.desc: Join Bianca Osbourne to taste and combine! Fun CombiNATION Plates host Bianca Osbourne starts this episode with an inspired tribute to Georgian cuisine; Beef Tartare with Tkemali (sour plum sauce), marigold powder, and tart, crunchy pickles. Next; feast your eyes on her unique Hong Kong dumpling: plump scallops, pork, and veggies are blended, rolled, steamed, sliced, and then served with Crispy Yu Choy and XO. The common ingredient is rabbit! Georgia offers up Rabbit 'Mtsvadi', grilled and glazed with pomegranate reduction. Hong Kong represents with Sweet and Sour Rabbit, Grilled Pineapple and Red Pepper Coulis. Finally, Georgian Milk Braised meets Chinese/Hong Kong-style Roast Duck with quail egg and cheese stuffed 'Khachapuri Dumpling' and crunchy 'Peking Duck Crumble', and it's a plate no-one has ever seen before!

programme.title: S01 : E06 South Korea + Spain - CombiNation Plates
programme.desc: CombiNATION Plates host Bianca Osbourne is always looking for the best food in the world to share. The first stop is South Korea with her Sesame Crusted Tuna 'Yukhoe', a delicious blend of favourite Korean flavours. Next stamp on the passport? Spain! Mouth-watering Duck Breast is seared and served rare with a crispy artichoke heart, membrillo, olives, and sweet-savoury sherry reduction. Beef short ribs are the common ingredient with Catalonian Braised and Romesco to one side and sticky Korean Kalbi-style grilled to the east! For the topper, drool over Bulgogi Octopus simmered and served with saffron-scented Sticky Rice Paella cakes, finished with crispy Paprika-Gochujang battered mussel. Yep, it tastes as good as it sounds!

programme.title: S01 : E07 Ethiopia + Brazil - CombiNation Plates
programme.desc: Travel the world without ever leaving the kitchen! Intrepid host of CombiNATION Plates, Bianca Osbourne, starts this episode with Ethiopian inspired Berbere Spiced Quail, seared in aromatic Niter Kibbeh, and served with crunchy-sour Gomen Salad. Brazil is next, check out this re- invention of Feijoada... with braised and seared pork belly, oranges, crema, and fresh black bean salsa. Common ingredient 'Coffee and Sweets' is next... with java-spiked Injera Crepe Cake for Ethiopia and Brazil blending up a dark roast of rich, coffee-spiked, chocolatey Brigadeiros truffles. The final plate is Coconut Crusted Black Cod with cheesy Brazilian-style Pao de Queijo bites, and teff flour a brush of spiced ghee inspired by Ethiopia.

programme.title: S01 : E08 Morocco + Thailand - CombiNation Plates
programme.desc: Join CombiNATION Plates host Bianca Osbourne for a trip to Morocco and Thailand! First up, whole Red Snapper is rubbed with earthy Ras el Hanout spice, poached in argan oil, and served with char-grilled oranges. Thailand inspires the next plate; Chicken Thigh 'Lollipop', roasted and served with bamboo shoots, chilies, and sauced with peanut-coconut red curry. Next, these countries both love Spring Rolls... Morocco's version, Briouat, is stuffed with saffron couscous and fresh cheese and fried... from Thailand comes a salad roll with shrimp and mango, dipped in a fiery green Nam Jim. Stick around for the big dish - Saffron buttERS-basted beef Striploin, served with complex Apricot-Green Curry Chutney and sent spinning with never before seen Chermoula Grass Jelly!

programme.title: S02 : E04 Tuscany - Bonacini's Italy
programme.desc: The popular region of Tuscany is known for its wines, cheeses, and gorgeous sights. Chef Michael Bonacini introduces us to Tuscany's fine cuisine with four of his favourite dishes. Michael draws attention to the importance of mushrooms in Tuscan culture with an antipasto: Many Mushroom soup. Warm, hearty, and full of earthy flavour, Michael tops this soup with fried sage leaves to combine comfort and crunch in a single bite. For his primo, Michael explores a Tuscan favourite - Lamb Ragu! Served over pici noodles, Michael's rich ragu is complemented by fresh, light herbs. Then, Michael serves up a Porchetta-Style Duck, a crispy and tender secondo. To bring his meal together, Michael ends with a smooth and decadent Creamy Coffee Custard any coffee fan will appreciate.

programme.title: S02 : E05 Veneto - Bonacini's Italy
programme.desc: From hearty inland crops to fresh food of the sea, the Venetian region covers it all. Host Michael Bonacini begins with the sea as he serves up an antipasto of succulent Soft Shell Crab. Michael pairs the crab with a Tangy Aioli made from sundried tomatoes, creating the perfect combination of crispy and creamy. Moving inland for his primo, Michael twists together two classic Venetian dishes to make a new favourite: Radicchio Risotto! With his secondo, Michael cooks up a light and creamy Pancetta-Wrapper Snapper with Pea Mash. Sweet and tender, this dish will melt in your mouth. Whether you're in the mood to share or feeling a little selfish, Michael's Giant Almond Crumb Biscuit covers it all. Buttery, sweet, and satisfyingly crumbly, this biscuit is sure to lead to a memorable dinner!

programme.title: S02 : E06 Puglia - Bonacini's Italy
programme.desc: Puglia's lush landscape and large coastline characterize its cuisine. Chef Michael Bonacini explores its native ingredients through some of Puglia's favourite meals. First up, Michael's antipasto is a guaranteed crunchy bite with crispy Fried Mussels. Stepping away from the sea, Michael highlights Puglia's prize crop: tomatoes! Combining colourful tomatoes with flavourful burrata cheese, Michael cooks up comfort in a bowl with his Tomato and Burrata Risotto. Taking on a more festive flair, Michael introduces us to Little Pork Bombs, the hottest street food in Puglia. With a filling of fresh herbs and melted cheese, these pork skewers are savoury and irresistible. Then, Michael introduces a classic Father's Day dessert for his dulce: Sour Cherry-on-Top Fritters. A dessert for strolling the street, Michal's crispy golden fritters topped with light mascarpone whipped cream will have you whipping them up at home as well!

programme.title: S02 : E07 Sicily - Bonacini's Italy
programme.desc: Simplicity is key with Sicilian cuisine and Chef Michael Bonacini explores just how the region balances simplicity with intensity through four flavourful dishes. Starting with an antipasto of Folded Flatbread with Ricotta and Fennel Seeds, Michael inspires with its intricate beauty with a simple recipe. Keeping to the theme of simplicity, Michael shows that plenty of flavour can come from little ingredients in his primo of Broccoli and Sausage Rigatoni. The spicy sausage and chili is countered by a creamy broccoli pesto for a dish that highlights Sicilian cuisine. Michael turns to the Italian queen of crops for his secondo: Eggplant Parmesan Roll-Ups. With thin slices of eggplant rolled up to contain a mouth-watering mixture of mozzarella, provolone, and pecorino romano, this dish gets an extra kick of flavour from a coating of breadcrumbs and tomato sauce. To bring it all together, Michael combines spicy with sweet through his tender Spiced Chocolate Cookies.

programme.title: S01 : E09 Bitter - The Wizard Of Sauce
programme.desc: Chef Kyle Crawford pulls back the curtain on bitter sauces! First up, a duo of chimichurris - one with black garlic! Next, a stout and espresso gravy for lamb and a traditional Georgian walnut sauce!

programme.title: S01 : E10 Fat - The Wizard Of Sauce
programme.desc: Chef Kyle Crawford pulls back the curtain on fatty sauces! First up, patatas bravas with aioli and brava sauce! Next, classic sauce choron on crab cakes and a duck fat-blood orange emulsion with duck confit!

programme.title: S01 : E01 Creamy - The Wizard Of Sauce
programme.desc: Chef Kyle Crawford pulls back the curtain on creamy sauces! First a duo of creamy butter sauces with salmon! Next up a sauce créme with beef tenderloin and a vegan coconut créme anglaise!

programme.title: S01 : E02 Savoury - The Wizard Of Sauce
programme.desc: Chef Kyle Crawford pulls back the curtain on savoury sauces! First up, a soy-miso-honey sauce for seared duck breast! Next, a black demi-glace for hanger steak and a sauce duxelles for scallops!

programme.title: S02 : E13 Italian dishes that will impress any dinner guest - One World Kitchen
programme.desc: From a trendy meatball appetizer to creamy pasta with chickpeas, decadent stuffed mussels, and succulent salmon with lavender and honey, Chef Vanessa Gianfrancesco wows again with her Italian cuisine.

programme.title: S02 : E16 Traditional Japanese Food - One World Kitchen

programme.desc: Starlite recibió al artista de origen libanés Mika y el público tuvo el privilegio de disfrutar de sus grandes éxitos, que han sonado por todo el mundo. Además el festival dió de nuevo la bienvenida a Norah Jones y Malú derrochó energía sobre el escenario con su nuevo espectáculo Mil batallas.

programme.title: S1:E4 Episodio 4 - Universo Starlite
programme.desc: En esta ocasión, las voces magistrales de Plácido Domingo, Ainhoa Arteta y Marta Sánchez nos dejarán sin aliento. El grupo ‘Il Divo’ realizará uno de sus conciertos más emotivos tras el fallecimiento de Carlos Marín y el madrileño C. Tangana revolucionará al público de la cantera.

programme.title: S1:E2 Episodio 2 - Universo Starlite
programme.desc: En este primer programa de ‘Universo Starlite’ podremos ver cómo se prepara la mítica cartera de Marbella para recibir a artistas como Sebastián Yatra o Jason Derulo.

programme.title: S1:E7 Los diseñadores y sus musas - Grandes Crónicas de ¡HOLA!
programme.desc: Antes eran diseñadores y maniquíes hasta que el maniquí cobró vida y la moda se convirtió en todo un espectáculo. Desde entonces estos artistas del diseño han trabajado con sus musas.

programme.title: S1:E16 Latinos transformando el futuro - Grandes Crónicas de ¡HOLA!
programme.desc: Durante más de 75 años la revista ¡HOLA! ha ido creciendo y cada vez son más y más los latinos que forman parte de esta gran familia.

programme.title: S1:E10 Glamour, deporte y amor - Grandes Crónicas de ¡HOLA!
programme.desc: Cuando hablábamos de celebridades pensábamos en actores, actrices, cantantes. Pero a esa lista hay que sumarle también a los deportistas, figuras que son muy seguidas y que vemos cada vez más en las alfombras rojas.

programme.title: S2:E10 Infanta Sofía - Royals
programme.desc: La infanta Sofía es la hija menor de los reyes de España y ocupa el segundo puesto en la línea de sucesión al trono. De carácter fuerte, perfeccionista y divertida, Sofía ha sido siempre un gran apoyo para su hermana, la princesa Leonor.

programme.title: S4:E4 Charlene de Monaco - Royals
programme.desc: Retrato de Su Alteza Serenísima Charlene de Mónaco, nacida en Zimbabwe y exnadadora olímpica.

programme.title: S1:E9 De la realidad a la realeza - Grandes Crónicas de ¡HOLA!
programme.desc: Hace medio siglo que un heredero europeo no se casa con una princesa. Y es que cada vez más las casas reales dan entrada a hombres y mujeres que no son sangre azul. Los tiempos están cambiando.

programme.title: S1:E9 Ep 9 Masterchef - Los reportajes de HOLA
programme.desc: Aspirantes… el tiempo comienza ¡ya!”, es la frase con la que el jurado del programa MasterChef da el pistoletazo de salida a las pruebas a las que cada semana se enfrentan los participantes de este concurso televisivo… Y ya van por la decimocuarta edición.

programme.title: Royals - La La Casa Danesa: Episodios 1-2
programme.desc: Royals - La La Casa Danesa: Mary de Dinamarca y Joaquín y Marie Cavallier

programme.title: S1:E3 Grandes damas para la historia - Grandes Crónicas de ¡HOLA!
programme.desc: Los presidentes del Gobierno de un país son elegidos para gobernar. Pero a su lado hay una figura que cada día cobra más interés y relevancia. Las primeras damas se han vuelto casi tan protagonistas como ellos.

programme.title: S1:E6 Episodio 6 - Universo Starlite
programme.desc: En un nuevo programa de 'Universo Starlite', podrás disfrutar del directo de una de las grandes leyendas vivas de la música: Nile Rodgers.

programme.title: S1:E1 La niña de Sanlúcar - Ana María, mi verdad
programme.desc: En este primer capítulo de su entrevista exclusiva tras su divorcio, Ana María Aldón nos descubre cómo fue su infancia en Sanlúcar de Barrameda y revela algunos de los episodios más duros y desconocidos de su vida.

programme.title: S1:E9 Episodio 9 - Universo Starlite
programme.desc: En este nuevo episodio, el sonido pop-folk de Passenger invadirá la cantera mientras que Marlon y Dvicio podrán el toque pop de la noche.

programme.title: S1:E1 Victoria Beckham - El armario de...
programme.desc: Con un sentido innato de la moda, Victoria Beckham marcaba estilo como estrella del pop en los 90 y ahora en su faceta de diseñadora de éxito.

programme.title: S1:E15 Cate Blanchett - El armario de...
programme.desc: Actriz multipremiada y con dos Óscar en su haber, Cate Blanchett es símbolo de la elegancia madura de Hollywood. Con un gusto exquisito y una elegancia innata, la australiana posee un estilo sobrio, chic y muy sofisticado.

programme.title: Lookbook con María Pombo T1: Episodios 1-3
programme.desc: Lookbook con María Pombo: Tendencias de otoño - Mis abrigos favoritos - Fiesta de pijamas con Álex Puértolas

programme.title: S4:E3 Carmen Corazzini - La Red Social de María
programme.desc: Es uno de los rostros más conocidos de Mediaset gracias a su trabajo como presentadora de informativos. Estudió periodismo y comunicación y se especializó en terrorismo y criminología.

programme.title: 20 Preguntas a... 5: Episodios 10-11
programme.desc: 20 Preguntas a...: Cristina Boscá - María Becerra.

programme.title: Stars - Chicos de portada: Episodios 8-9
programme.desc: Stars - Chicos de portada: Brad Pitt - Iñigo Onieva

programme.title: S3:E11 Las presentadoras de Deportes de la tele - La Red Social de María
programme.desc: Hubo un tiempo en el que la información deportiva en TV era cosa de hombres. Afortunadamente las cosas han cambiado y ahora son ellas las que, en muchos casos, llevan la voz cantante y son las caras visibles de la crónica deportiva.

programme.title: S1:E3 Cindy Kimberly | Camilo - 20 Preguntas a...
programme.desc: Cindy Kimberly enamoró al mismísimo Justin Bieber cuando en 2015 el cantante subía una foto de la joven a sus redes acompañada de la frase: ¿quién es ella? | Si todavía no habías escuchado el nombre de Camilo Echeverry es que probablemente no sintonices mucho la radio.

programme.title: S4:E1 Xavier Sardá - La Red Social de María
programme.desc: María Palacios entrevista a Javier Sardá. Juntos repasan la trayectoria del popular periodista.

programme.title: S1:E17 Cachopo asturiano: la receta tradicional - La Cocina de ¡HOLA!
programme.desc: El cachopo es uno de los platos más típicos de Asturias y Pepa Muñoz nos enseña a hacerlo a la manera tradicional tal y como se hace en el Principado.

programme.title: S1:E19 La receta secreta de la tarta de queso de Pepa - La Cocina de ¡HOLA!
programme.desc: Hay muchas maneras de hacer una tarta de queso y la de Pepa tiene mucha fama entre los que la han probado. Este postre, además, va acompañado de frutos rojos que contienen muchas propiedades para prevenir diversas enfermedades.

programme.title: S1:E26 La mejor receta de lentejas con chorizo o vegetarianas - La Cocina de ¡HOLA!
programme.desc: De toda la vida, estofadas con chorizo y punta de jamón. La chef Pepa Muñoz elige este plato de cuchara tan popular como nutritivo y delicioso.

programme.title: S1:E6 Alcachofas con jamón y para vegetarianos - La Cocina de ¡HOLA!

programme.title: Whats On Conferences, Startups and Innovation
programme.sub-title: Whats On Conferences, Startups and Innovation
programme.desc: A new world is being built right now across the Mediterranean, and we are taking you behind the scenes of the most important meetings of the year. This week, we are at the historic Mediterranean Conference Centre in Valletta for MedTech World, where the conversation has shifted from simple gadgets to responsible AI that doctors and patients can actually trust. We then head south to the incredible energy of AfricaIgnite to meet the founders of high-growth startups in climate tech and finance who are proving that Africa is the new engine of global innovation. Back on the islands, we explore the Startup Malta Festival to see how a pro-business ecosystem is helping entrepreneurs scale their boldest ideas across Europe. Finally, we join the global dialogue at the Finance Malta Conference to see how a focus on quality over quantity is redefining the future of investment and sustainability. This is a journey through the ideas and the people who are turning today's challenges into the success stories of the future.

programme.desc: Muchas colonias europeas compitieron por el dominio y la supremacía cultural en Bengala. Como resultado, su cocina absorbió muchas influencias occidentales.

programme.title: S01 : E05 Relajación Earl's Regency, Sri Lanka - Unwind
programme.desc: Indeya se relaja en Earl's Regency y explora sus aspectos espirituales y culturales. Visita un santuario de vida silvestre, prueba una comida tradicional y termina explorando los alrededores del lago Kandy.

programme.title: S01 : E21 La Búsqueda Fort Begu 1, India - Quest
programme.desc: Hambriento de historias y sabores de un reino pasado, Alex conoce a Rana Sawai Harisingh II, el 24º descendiente de la familia real Begu.

programme.title: S01 : E01 Spas del Mundo Kamalaya, Tailandia - World Spas
programme.desc: Ubicado en una hermosa ladera en Koh Samui, Tailandia, Kamalaya es un santuario de bienestar aislado con playa privada. Aquí, Jamie Srubis prueba una variedad de tratamientos de spa, como el tratamiento de envoltura y exfoliación corporal desintoxicante Swaadhika, que incluye una sesión de sauna de infrarrojos lejanos y un masaje de drenaje linfático. También prueba el yoga y el aeróbic acuático y luego disfruta de una comida desintoxicante.

programme.title: S01 : E18 La Búsqueda Karni Fort, India - Quest
programme.desc: Después de encontrar las recetas escritas a mano de sus abuelos, Vikramaditya Sodawas, el propietario de Karni Fort, decidió revivir las preciadas recetas de su familia.

programme.title: S01 : E12 Grandiosos Hoteles del Mundo Six Senses, Tailandia - Great World Hotels
programme.desc: Rodeado de aguas turquesas, playas vírgenes y exuberante vegetación tropical, Koh Samui ofrece a Elisha la combinación perfecta de serenidad y lujo.

programme.title: S01 : E03 Xplora Austria Innsbruck - Xplore Austria
programme.desc: En un viaje a Innsbruck, Eliseo descubre historias de un emperador del siglo XV, bajo cuyo reinado la ciudad alcanzó su apogeo.

programme.title: S01 : E18 La Búsqueda Naila 2, India - Quest
programme.desc: Khargosh es un plato olvidable ya que hay varios pasos para prepararlo y además lleva mucho tiempo.

programme.title: S01 : E02 Grandiosos Hoteles del Mundo Closenberg, Sri Lanka - Great World Hotels
programme.desc: Moeen, un entusiasta de los viajes, realiza una escapada corta al Hotel Closenberg en Galle, una ciudad amurallada holandesa del siglo XVIII en Sri Lanka con grandes casas coloniales y hermosas playas. En el resort, se topa con una boda tradicional de Sri Lanka, lo que le ofrece una idea de las tradiciones y la cocina del país.

programme.title: S01 : E02 Xplora Austria Salzburgo - Xplore Austria
programme.desc: Elisha está asombrado por la herencia musical de Salzburgo, que fue el escenario de las composiciones de Mozart y de la historia de la familia Von Trapp.

programme.title: S01 : E03 Fuera del Mapa Minicoy, India - Off The Grid
programme.desc: Alex se propone explorar los pueblos de la remota isla de Minicoy y termina en una fiesta local.

programme.title: S01 : E17 La Búsqueda Naila 1, India - Quest
programme.desc: Alex visita la ciudad rosa de Jaipur, India, para aprender otro par de platos olvidados. Recetas de Naila que hacen que el plato sea épico.

programme.title: S01 : E01 Xplora Austria Viena 2 - Xplore Austria
programme.desc: Elisha descubre el lado contemporáneo de Viena en algunos de sus barrios más modernos y animados.

programme.title: S01 : E02 Fuera del Mapa Kadmat, India - Off The Grid
programme.desc: Desde nadar con tortugas centenarias hasta visitar una fábrica de cocos, Alex tiene muchas experiencias poco convencionales en las islas de Lakshadweep.

programme.title: S01 : E16 La Búsqueda Calcuta 3, India - Quest
programme.desc: Alex conoce a algunos dueños de tiendas de dulces veteranos en Calcuta, quienes le enseñan a preparar dulces bengalíes olvidados.

programme.title: S01 : E17 Espacios en la Ciudad Múnich, Alemania - City Breaks
programme.desc: Desde palacios hasta museos, los edificios de Múnich son una mezcla fascinante de arquitectura tradicional bávara y diseño de vanguardia.

programme.title: S01 : E01 Xplora República Checa Kutná Hora - Xplore Czech Republic
programme.desc: La antigua ciudad minera de plata de Kutná Hora fue la segunda ciudad más importante del Reino medieval de Bohemia después de Praga. Rohan Patoley aprende sobre las antiguas glorias de la ciudad en la antigua casa de la moneda real, la corte italiana, y se sumerge en el romance de la pintoresca bodega Vinné Sklepy. También asiste al Royal Silvering Festival, una celebración gótica anual que recuerda el rico pasado de la ciudad.

programme.title: S01 : E01 Mochila El Cairo, Egipto - Backpack
programme.desc: La Mochila es la historia de un viajero solitario que emprende en una misión para descubrir la belleza, complejidad y carácter de diferentes lugares del mundo.

programme.title: S01 : E08 La Búsqueda Lucknow & Rewa - Quest
programme.desc: Dé un paseo por las calles de Lucknow y deléitese con una comida reconfortante y también descubra algunas recetas antiguas favoritas para compartir y conservar en este episodio de Quest.

programme.title: S01 : E03 Relajación Park Hyatt, Maldivas - Unwind
programme.desc: Indeya, se relaja en un lujoso resort isleño de las Maldivas. Al estar alojada en una villa con piscina, va a avistar delfines, hacer snorkel, practicar yoga y aprender una receta de pescado, para terminar con una cena al aire libre.

programme.title: S01 : E55 Guía XP Copenhague - Xp Guide
programme.desc: Elisha visita el parque de atracciones más antiguo del mundo: Tivoli Garden en Copenhague, que es la inspiración para Disneyland.

programme.title: S01 : E02 Espacios en la Ciudad Madrid, España - City Breaks
programme.desc: No hay mejor lugar para sentir el "duende", el espíritu y la pasión de España que su animada capital, Madrid. Alex capta algo de la contagiosa vivacidad de la ciudad en sus bulliciosas plazas como el Puerto del Sol y la Plaza Mayor. Experimenta el amor de los españoles por la comida mientras saborea auténticos churros españoles. También conoce la rica y compleja historia de la ciudad en lugares como la Catedral de la Almudena y el Palacio Real de Madrid.

programme.title: S01 : E14 La Búsqueda Calcuta 1, India - Quest
programme.desc: En Calcuta, Alex conoce a Rajiv Neogi y Siddhartha Bose, expertos gastronómicos que le presentan algunos de los platos olvidados de la cocina bengalí.

programme.title: S01 : E02 Spas del Mundo Fusión Maia, Vietnam - World Spas
programme.desc: Natural Living Massage, uno de los tratamientos exclusivos del complejo spa todo incluido Fusion Maia en Da Nang, Vietnam, es una combinación de curación oriental y aromaterapia. Jamie Srubis prueba esto junto con otros tratamientos como un masaje linfático tibio con bambú, que es bueno para desintoxicar, y Mindful Energy, un tratamiento de spa que combina reiki con una sesión de masaje de cabeza.

programme.title: S01 : E11 Guía XP Wayanad, India - Xp Guide
programme.desc: Wayanad, un pueblo bucólico de Kerala, ofrece un itinerario lleno de vida silvestre, ayurveda, plantaciones y spas.

programme.title: S01 : E13 La Búsqueda Shillong, India - Quest
programme.desc: Mientras cocina el pescado local de la región Jaintia de Meghalaya, Alex también se familiariza con la herencia culinaria de Sylhet en Bangladesh.

programme.title: S01 : E05 Xplora República Checa Praga - Xplore Czech Republic
programme.desc: Con un incomparable encanto del viejo mundo, Praga es la respuesta de la República Checa a París. Es considerada una de las ciudades más bellas del mundo. Rohan Patoley aprende sobre la historia y la arquitectura de esta fascinante ciudad en lugares como el majestuoso castillo de Praga, la plaza Wenceslao y un cementerio judío. Pero la mejor experiencia que tiene en Praga es cuando interactúa con el Palacio del Príncipe de Lobkowicz.

programme.title: S01 : E07 Espacios en la Ciudad Budapest, Hungría - City Breaks
programme.desc: Desde la iglesia de San Matías hasta el Palacio Real, Catriona explora las atracciones icónicas de Budapest, "el París del Este".

programme.title: S01 : E06 Xplora Austria Viena 1 - Xplore Austria
programme.desc: Desde una ópera hasta palacios barrocos, las magníficas reliquias del pasado imperial de Viena tienen muchas historias que contar.

programme.title: S01 : E01 Fuera del Mapa Kavaratti, India - Off The Grid
programme.desc: A través de aventuras como el paravelismo en Kavaratti y el buceo en Bangaram, Alex descubre la belleza de las islas de coral de Lakshadweep.

programme.title: S01 : E15 La Búsqueda Kolkata 2, India - Quest
programme.desc: Muchas colonias europeas compitieron por el dominio y la supremacía cultural en Bengala. Como resultado, su cocina absorbió muchas influencias occidentales.

programme.title: S01 : E05 Relajación Earl's Regency, Sri Lanka - Unwind
programme.desc: Indeya se relaja en Earl's Regency y explora sus aspectos espirituales y culturales. Visita un santuario de vida silvestre, prueba una comida tradicional y termina explorando los alrededores del lago Kandy.

programme.title: S01 : E21 La Búsqueda Fort Begu 1, India - Quest
programme.desc: Hambriento de historias y sabores de un reino pasado, Alex conoce a Rana Sawai Harisingh II, el 24º descendiente de la familia real Begu.

programme.title: S01 : E01 Spas del Mundo Kamalaya, Tailandia - World Spas
programme.desc: Ubicado en una hermosa ladera en Koh Samui, Tailandia, Kamalaya es un santuario de bienestar aislado con playa privada. Aquí, Jamie Srubis prueba una variedad de tratamientos de spa, como el tratamiento de envoltura y exfoliación corporal desintoxicante Swaadhika, que incluye una sesión de sauna de infrarrojos lejanos y un masaje de drenaje linfático. También prueba el yoga y el aeróbic acuático y luego disfruta de una comida desintoxicante.

programme.title: S01 : E18 La Búsqueda Karni Fort, India - Quest
programme.desc: Después de encontrar las recetas escritas a mano de sus abuelos, Vikramaditya Sodawas, el propietario de Karni Fort, decidió revivir las preciadas recetas de su familia.

programme.title: S01 : E12 Grandiosos Hoteles del Mundo Six Senses, Tailandia - Great World Hotels
programme.desc: Rodeado de aguas turquesas, playas vírgenes y exuberante vegetación tropical, Koh Samui ofrece a Elisha la combinación perfecta de serenidad y lujo.

programme.title: S01 : E03 Xplora Austria Innsbruck - Xplore Austria
programme.desc: En un viaje a Innsbruck, Eliseo descubre historias de un emperador del siglo XV, bajo cuyo reinado la ciudad alcanzó su apogeo.

programme.title: S01 : E18 La Búsqueda Naila 2, India - Quest
programme.desc: Khargosh es un plato olvidable ya que hay varios pasos para prepararlo y además lleva mucho tiempo.

programme.title: S01 : E02 Grandiosos Hoteles del Mundo Closenberg, Sri Lanka - Great World Hotels
programme.desc: Moeen, un entusiasta de los viajes, realiza una escapada corta al Hotel Closenberg en Galle, una ciudad amurallada holandesa del siglo XVIII en Sri Lanka con grandes casas coloniales y hermosas playas. En el resort, se topa con una boda tradicional de Sri Lanka, lo que le ofrece una idea de las tradiciones y la cocina del país.

programme.title: S01 : E02 Xplora Austria Salzburgo - Xplore Austria
programme.desc: Elisha está asombrado por la herencia musical de Salzburgo, que fue el escenario de las composiciones de Mozart y de la historia de la familia Von Trapp.

programme.title: S01 : E03 Fuera del Mapa Minicoy, India - Off The Grid
programme.desc: Alex se propone explorar los pueblos de la remota isla de Minicoy y termina en una fiesta local.

programme.title: S01 : E17 La Búsqueda Naila 1, India - Quest
programme.desc: Alex visita la ciudad rosa de Jaipur, India, para aprender otro par de platos olvidados. Recetas de Naila que hacen que el plato sea épico.

programme.title: S01 : E01 Xplora Austria Viena 2 - Xplore Austria
programme.desc: Elisha descubre el lado contemporáneo de Viena en algunos de sus barrios más modernos y animados.

programme.title: S01 : E02 Fuera del Mapa Kadmat, India - Off The Grid
programme.desc: Desde nadar con tortugas centenarias hasta visitar una fábrica de cocos, Alex tiene muchas experiencias poco convencionales en las islas de Lakshadweep.

programme.title: S01 : E16 La Búsqueda Calcuta 3, India - Quest
programme.desc: Alex conoce a algunos dueños de tiendas de dulces veteranos en Calcuta, quienes le enseñan a preparar dulces bengalíes olvidados.

programme.title: S01 : E07 Espacios en la Ciudad Budapest, Hungría - City Breaks
programme.desc: Desde la iglesia de San Matías hasta el Palacio Real, Catriona explora las atracciones icónicas de Budapest, "el París del Este".

programme.title: S01 : E01 Fuera Del Mapa Wild Atlantic Way 1, Irlanda - Off The Grid
programme.desc: Al comenzar su viaje por la Ruta Atlántica Salvaje desde Dublín, Alex planea conducir hasta el final y hace su primera parada en "Cliffs of Moher". Luego se detiene en el pueblo de Kildare y comprende la cultura irlandesa. Visita el Centro de Arte Claddagh. Además, su siguiente parada es el Castillo de Ashford, que ahora es una propiedad de lujo de 5 estrellas y luego la Escuela de Falcony de Irlanda. Más adelante en su viaje, visita a Croagh Patrick en Westport y luego, al finalizar el episodio, recorre 60 kilómetros en bicicleta hasta Mulranny.

programme.title: S01 : E01 Xplora Omán Muscat - Xplore Oman
programme.desc: En una visita a Mascate, la capital de Omán, Elisha Kriis se encuentra boquiabierta ante la magnificencia de la Gran Mezquita del Sultán Qaboos, que domina el horizonte de la ciudad. Mientras se pierde en los tesoros de Oriente Medio en el famoso Muttrah Souq, comienza a experimentar los clásicos encantos árabes de Omán.

programme.title: S01 : E01 10 Días En Corea Seoul - 10 Days Korea
programme.desc: Seúl, la capital de Corea del Sur, es una ciudad dinámica que forja sin miedo un camino hacia el futuro preservando fielmente sus raíces. Andrew Maciver, adicto a los viajes, prueba las delicias locales en los Pojangmachas, carritos de comida callejera típicos coreanos, de los animados mercados de Myeongdong. También ve las atracciones icónicas de la ciudad, como el templo Jogyesa, Daedongmun, que es la puerta este de la ciudad, y el palacio Gyeongbokgung, que alguna vez sirvió como sede de uno de los imperios más grandes del Asia medieval.

programme.title: S01 : E04 Mochila Bali, Indonesia - Backpack
programme.desc: Bali, un escondite tropical, logra ser un paraíso para los buscadores de aventuras, un santuario espiritual, un paraíso para los amantes de la comida y el retiro de un entusiasta de la naturaleza, todo al mismo tiempo. Esto es algo que Hannah Jackson descubre por sí misma mientras explora los templos de Bali, como el templo de Ulan Danu, prueba mariscos deliciosos y ultrafrescos, disfruta de algunas actividades de aventura como un paseo por el mar y visita un criadero de tortugas.

programme.title: S01 : E07 Grandiosos Hoteles Del Mundo Huvafen Fushi 1, Maldives - Great World Hotels
programme.desc: Un viaje a Maldivas es como un viaje a un gran paraíso de aguas azules. Una villa con piso, que ofrece vistas claras del océano turquesa y la exquisita vida marina bajo sus pies, realza esta experiencia para Kim durante su visita. Se mima aún más con un tratamiento de spa bajo el agua y una botella de vino de una bodega subterránea, que es como una cueva del tesoro para los conocedores del vino de todo el mundo.

Mientras se pierde en los tesoros de Oriente Medio en el famoso Muttrah Souq, comienza a experimentar los clásicos encantos árabes de Omán.

programme.title: S01 : E01 10 Días En Corea Seoul - 10 Days Korea
programme.desc: Seúl, la capital de Corea del Sur, es una ciudad dinámica que forja sin miedo un camino hacia el futuro preservando fielmente sus raíces. Andrew Maciver, adicto a los viajes, prueba las delicias locales en los Pojangmachas, carritos de comida callejera típicos coreanos, de los animados mercados de Myeongdong. También ve las atracciones icónicas de la ciudad, como el templo Jogyesa, Daedongmun, que es la puerta este de la ciudad, y el palacio Gyeongbokgung, que alguna vez sirvió como sede de uno de los imperios más grandes del Asia medieval.

programme.title: S01 : E04 Mochila Bali, Indonesia - Backpack
programme.desc: Bali, un escondite tropical, logra ser un paraíso para los buscadores de aventuras, un santuario espiritual, un paraíso para los amantes de la comida y el retiro de un entusiasta de la naturaleza, todo al mismo tiempo. Esto es algo que Hannah Jackson descubre por sí misma mientras explora los templos de Bali, como el templo de Ulan Danu, prueba mariscos deliciosos y ultrafrescos, disfruta de algunas actividades de aventura como un paseo por el mar y visita un criadero de tortugas.

programme.title: S01 : E07 Grandiosos Hoteles Del Mundo Huvafen Fushi 1, Maldives - Great World Hotels
programme.desc: Un viaje a Maldivas es como un viaje a un gran paraíso de aguas azules. Una villa con piso, que ofrece vistas claras del océano turquesa y la exquisita vida marina bajo sus pies, realza esta experiencia para Kim durante su visita. Se mima aún más con un tratamiento de spa bajo el agua y una botella de vino de una bodega subterránea, que es como una cueva del tesoro para los conocedores del vino de todo el mundo.

programme.title: S01 : E01 Fuera Del Mapa Wild Atlantic Way 1, Irlanda - Off The Grid
programme.desc: Al comenzar su viaje por la Ruta Atlántica Salvaje desde Dublín, Alex planea conducir hasta el final y hace su primera parada en "Cliffs of Moher". Luego se detiene en el pueblo de Kildare y comprende la cultura irlandesa. Visita el Centro de Arte Claddagh. Además, su siguiente parada es el Castillo de Ashford, que ahora es una propiedad de lujo de 5 estrellas y luego la Escuela de Falcony de Irlanda. Más adelante en su viaje, visita a Croagh Patrick en Westport y luego, al finalizar el episodio, recorre 60 kilómetros en bicicleta hasta Mulranny.
